title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year in three equal 4-monthly installments directly transferred to bank accounts of farmer families.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support against unforeseen non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest.
benefits: Affordable premium (1.5% to 2% max), comprehensive claim settlement

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Timely credit for crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, consumption requirements, and maintenance of farm assets at concessional interest rate of 4% (with prompt repayment).
benefits: Up to ₹3 Lakh institutional credit at 4% interest rate

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
description: Subsidies for precision micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) to enhance water efficiency and crop productivity.
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers, 45% for other farmers

title: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Subsidies on purchase of agricultural machinery including power tillers, tractors, combine harvesters, laser land levelers, and custom hiring centers.
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on procurement of agricultural machinery

title: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Promotion of organic farming through cluster approach and PGS (Participatory Guarantee System) certification. Financial assistance of ₹50,000/ha for organic conversion.
benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare financial aid for organic inputs and certification

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides customized soil fertility status and nutrient dosage recommendations for 12 parameters to optimize fertilizer use and increase yield.
benefits: Free periodic soil testing and dosage report every 2 years

title: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee
description: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Expansion of Coffee" by the Coffee Board, Department of Commerce, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, aims to facilitate afforestation in the Jhum lands and help settle the tribals on a permanent footing.

title: Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar
ministry: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: The Rashtriya Krishi Vigyan Puraskar (RKVP) aims to honor scientists and technical experts for outstanding contributions and innovations in agriculture and allied sciences.

title: Assistance for Planting Vegetable Crops for Raw and Ripe Mandap
description: The scheme provides financial assistance to farmers in Gujarat for setting up vegetable trellises (Mandap) for raw, semi-ripe, and ripe vegetables, with varying support for General, SC, and ST farmers.

title: A Program to Provide 90 Percent Assistance in Planting Material of Horticultural Fruit Crops
description: This scheme offers 90% financial assistance to farmers for purchasing planting materials of fruit crops to promote horticulture.

title: Krishi Vidya Nidhi Yojana
description: The scheme aims to provide merit-based financial assistance to children of CM-KISAN beneficiaries pursuing professional and technical courses, supporting higher education through Direct Benefit Transfer.

title: To Increase Fish Seed Production and Inland Fisheries Resources in Tribal Areas: Training Kit - Gujarat
description: The scheme aims to provide training and equipment to boost inland fisheries among Scheduled Tribe beneficiaries.

title: Udhyan Card
description: It aims to create a unified identification system for farmers engaged in horticulture activities, enabling them to access all horticulture-related schemes and benefits provided by the Government of Uttarakhand.

title: Establishment of Vermicompost Units
description: The scheme aims to promote sustainable agriculture and organic farming by providing financial assistance for setting up vermicompost units to farmers and women self-help groups.

title: Very Dense Apple Plantation Scheme
description: The scheme aims to promote intensive apple cultivation among farmers by establishing modern orchards with high-yielding varieties and providing financial assistance through a 60% subsidy on saplings, thereby enhancing productivity and increasing farmers’ income.

title: Aromatic Awareness Programme - Centre for Aromatic Plants
description: The scheme aims to raise awareness about aromatic plants and their benefits, and to provide guidance on cultivation practices suitable to different agricultural climates.
